en: Multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard showing the village of Schmannewitz, a street scene with a decorated building labeled as Café Jacob–Konditorei, and a posed studio photograph of four young women in traditional dresses identified as the Schmannewitzer Heidelerchen and Geschwister Jacob. The surrounding caption text promotes Schmannewitz as a holiday resort (Ferienort) in Saxony (in Sa.).
